description.zh:
SQL限流的生效时长，单位为秒。
>限流规则仅在生效时间内开启。
description.en:
The duration within which the SQL throttling rule takes effect. Unit: seconds.

> The throttling rule takes effect only within this duration.

description.zh:
实例ID。
>仅支持RDS MySQL和 PolarDB MySQL版实例。
description.en:
The instance ID.

> You must specify the instance ID only if your database instance is an ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance or a PolarDB for MySQL cluster.

description.zh:
SQL最大并发数，取值为大于或等于1的整数。
>当包含关键词的SQL达到最大并发数时会触发限流规则。
description.en:
The maximum number of concurrent SQL statements. Set this parameter to a positive integer.

> When the number of concurrent SQL statements that contain the specified keywords reaches this upper limit, the throttling rule is triggered.

description.zh:
需要限流的SQL关键词。
>多个关键词间用波浪线（~）分隔，SQL语句中需要同时包含这些关键词才会触发限流规则。
description.en:
The keywords that are used to identify the SQL statements that need to be throttled.

> If you specify multiple SQL keywords, separate them with tildes (\~). If the number of concurrent SQL statements that contain all the specified SQL keywords reaches the specified upper limit, the throttling rule is triggered.

The type of the SQL statements. Valid values:

- **SELECT**

- **UPDATE**

- **DELETE**

descriptions.zh:
本接口适用的数据库引擎为：
- RDS MySQL
- PolarDB MySQL版
descriptions.en:
This operation supports the following database engines:

- ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL

- PolarDB for MySQL

example.unifiedCli: aliyun das enable-sql-concurrency-control --console-context None --instance-id rm-2ze1jdv45i7l60000 --sql-type SELECT --max-concurrency 3 --sql-keywords 'call~open~api~test~4~from~POP' --concurrency-control-time 300 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun das EnableSqlConcurrencyControl --region cn-hangzhou --SqlKeywords 'call~open~api~test~4~from~POP' --ConsoleContext None --ConcurrencyControlTime 300 --InstanceId 'rm-2ze1jdv45i7l60000' --MaxConcurrency 3 --SqlType SELECT
